text:
deploy-bot: starting eu region blue/green rollout -> green instance group (g-eu-12) at 2469123456
Maya Rao: noticed small spike in 5xxs from EU customers, dashboard shows errors concentrated on edge nodes A-D :thinking_face:
Jun Park: looking at CDN logs, approx 48% of requests hitting green are returning 502 from origin, others OK. seems split traffic (50/50)
Alex Kim: PagerDuty triggered: P2 - eu-edge-origin-502s. I'm on it.
PagerDuty: Incident opened: P2 - eu-edge-origin-502s (pager oncall: @ops-oncall)
ops-oncall: acked. what's the deploy id?
Maya Rao: deploy id: deploy-2026-03-15-eu-green-1, started at root ts. Canary passed internal checks but full canary -> half traffic.
Sophie Li: quick check: green instances are healthy from infra side, but origin pool g-eu-12 shows increased connection resets. suspect stale cache or connection pool mismatch at edge proxies.
Jun Park: reproducing with cURL from eu test node shows intermittent 502s when request includes `x-consistent-read:true`. removing header returns 200 consistently. odd.
Alex Kim: that header is only set by the new feature-flag `consistent_read_v2` that shipped with green. rolling back flag sounds fastest.
ops-oncall: can we flip the feature flag kill-switch? who owns it?
Maya Rao: I own the flag. Flipping now to off for eu region only.
Maya Rao: toggled `consistent_read_v2` -> OFF (eu). monitoring...
InfraBot: flag-change: consistent_read_v2 set to false for scope=region:eu by Maya Rao at 2469123580
Jun Park: errors dropping already, 502 -> 5%. still some traces.
Alex Kim: starting controlled rollback of green -> routing back to blue for eu. initiating route lift on edge.
deploy-bot: routing change request submitted: route-weight(eu): blue=100, green=0 (async)
Sophie Li: note: DNS TTL was 30s, but edge caches had sticky connections at 2m. we'll do connection drains on green nodes.
Maya Rao: initiated drain on g-eu-12, `kubectl drain` + connection close on proxies.
Jun Park: connection close cmds sent. logs show 10 connection resets as we drain. customers affected estimated ~0.8% of global requests during event window.
Alex Kim: customer impact: EU customers on a small subset of edge nodes might have seen transient 502s for up to ~120s. No data loss reported.
ops-oncall: paging update: stakeholders notified, SOC ticket created, PSR prep started.
PagerDuty: update: incident severity remains P2 while we confirm full recovery.
InfraBot: healthcheck: all edge nodes show 200s for 60s consecutive after route change.
Jun Park: confirming metrics stable for 5m. cost of rollback minimal.
Maya Rao: handing off to oncall for post-incident follow-up. @ops-oncall you own the rest.
ops-oncall: taking over incident. will coordinate postmortem, timeline, and customer comms. scheduling RCA meeting for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Alex Kim: quick mitigation notes to add to PSR: 1) feature-flag scoped rollout for config-hash mismatch 2) add edge-proxy connection drain on weight flips 3) expand canary to 10% with longer soak for flags touching origin behavior
Sophie Li: created ticket INF-2145 to add connection-drain hook to route flips, and TICKET-PRIORITY set to high.
Maya Rao: thanks all. closing thread for live action; will append logs and timeline to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: incident closed for now, will mark resolved after RCA.
